offering_description.value: Provides commercial landscape maintenance, enhancement and irrigation services to property owners and managers across the United States. Delivers the work through a branch network of crews and equipment under recurring maintenance contracts and installation projects.

primary_products.value: landscape plants; irrigation equipment; outdoor lighting

primary_services.value: landscape maintenance; landscape enhancement installation; irrigation services; tree care; snow and ice removal

customer_segment.value: B2B: commercial property owners, property managers, homeowner associations and multifamily communities; B2G: municipalities and public agencies with grounds to maintain

end_markets.value: commercial real estate; multifamily residential; healthcare; education; retail; hospitality

revenue_model.value: service fees: recurring landscape maintenance contracts for ongoing grounds care; project or contract: enhancement and installation projects for new or renovated landscapes

value_chain_position.value: service provider: performs landscape maintenance and installation work, selling labor, materials and equipment to property owners and managers

geography_served.value: US national: branch network covering much of the United States

specialization.value: related lines: maintenance, enhancements, irrigation, tree care and snow removal sold to the same commercial property customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling contracts to property owners and managers; own locations: company-operated branch offices serving local customer sites

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: state pesticide application licensing, OSHA worker safety rules and environmental rules for landscape work
